title: National total and groundwater storage
caption: TWSA uses the primary CSR record through September 2024; derived GWSA ends September 2023. Missing satellite months remain gaps. Negative anomalies mean storage below the 2004–2009 reference, not a negative absolute water volume.

title: Total storage / Groundwater storage
caption: Seasonal Sen slopes for all 22 basins. Negative rates indicate decline. Basin significance, intervals and sample counts are reported separately. All basins share broad GRACE support.

title: Native rainfall / Potential ET / CHIRPS rainfall
caption: Available-month means, 2003–2023. Native rainfall and PET drive the reconstruction; CHIRPS supplies alternative rainfall. Monthly fluxes are distinct from storage anomalies.

title: Rainfall and storage seasonal timing
caption: Six geographically distributed illustrative basins; all 22 remain in the numerical release. Boxes show interannual native rainfall by month (quartiles and 1.5-IQR whiskers; outliers suppressed); pink line is mean observed TWSA on its own right-hand axis. Distribution spread is not a confidence interval.

title: Weather reconstruction of naturalized storage
caption: The shaded years 2016–2023 were excluded from training and model selection. Close curves show reconstruction of the parent model; they do not independently establish the true natural climate counterfactual.

title: Held-out TWSA reconstruction agreement
caption: 2016–2023 test months, six geographical examples. Grey is identity; pink is a descriptive fit. Metrics compare predictions directly with the parent target. Basin selection is geographic, not based on model performance; all 22 basin metrics are provided.

title: Total-storage anomaly skill / Groundwater anomaly skill
caption: NSE compares squared error with the target-mean benchmark; 1 is perfect, 0 equals that benchmark and negative is worse. Monthly climatology comes only from training. The target is naturalized WaterGAP.

title: Matching land-storage histories
caption: This comparison excludes groundwater and open surface water. GLDAS is a cross-model benchmark, not an observed total-storage or human-only validation dataset.

title: Land-storage NSE / Land-storage RMSE
caption: Matching soil, canopy and snow compartments on paired dates. Higher NSE and lower RMSE mean closer model agreement for this same target. They do not validate the residual.

title: Residual compared with the modeled human effect
caption: Residual = observed − naturalized. Modeled human effect = historical − naturalized. Unexplained gap = observed − historical. Thus residual = modeled human effect + unexplained gap. A negative residual is not measured pumping.

title: Total-storage residual / Groundwater residual
caption: Calendar-month fixed-effect OLS on common available dates. These additive rates differ from the primary seasonal Sen estimates. Residuals include human effects and observation/model discrepancy.

title: How climate and residual variability change over time
caption: Annual mean absolute deviations on the same available months (minimum eight). Ratios need not sum to one and may exceed one because components covary. These are not climate/human percentages.

title: Processing-chain sensitivity
caption: Common-date basin trends differ across CSR and COST-G/G3P. Rank correlations are 0.138 for TWSA and 0.027 for GWSA; both gravity and compartment processing differ.

title: Weather memory improves reconstruction
caption: Controlled Ridge comparison; boxplots describe basin variation, not confidence intervals. National test anomaly NSE improves from 0.283 to 0.890 for TWSA and 0.039 to 0.723 for GWSA.

title: Skill changes between test years
caption: National annual anomaly NSE against the naturalized parent. The 2022 groundwater score is −1.067 and is retained; pooled scores hide this failure.

title: ENSO timing in storage components
caption: National partial correlations remove season, trend and contemporaneous DMI, 2003–2023. All five selected ENSO leads are shown. The residual has a weaker six-month association, but this does not prove complete climate removal.

title: Model reconstruction during ENSO phases
caption: Held-out parent reconstruction, with 29 El Niño, 36 neutral and 31 La Niña months. Months share events; this is not independent event prediction.

title: Independent reservoir component evidence
caption: Scene-supported values, with season and trend removed, then standardized. Points preserve observation gaps. Adjusted national r = 0.439 across 73 months; year-cluster 95% interval 0.188–0.665.

title: Groundwater consistency and its spatial limits
caption: Annual residual–head correlations. Hatching indicates inadequate support. Head and basin storage have different units and observation scales; no storage-volume validation is implied.

title: Groundwater levels and groundwater residual timing
caption: Six geographical examples on jointly available annual support. Standardization permits a timing comparison but does not convert head into groundwater volume. Short samples and changing stations limit inference; gaps remain missing.

title: Thailand principal basins
caption: The 22 ONWR basins are reporting polygons. Adjacent basins share broad GRACE support.
